description: Proto (Proto Global Ltd.) is headquartered in Waterloo, Canada, with offices in Taguig (Philippines) and Kigali (Rwanda). It sells an AI customer-service and grievance-redress platform to governments, financial regulators and enterprises, plus a self-serve Voice API (TTS and ASR) billed in prepaid per-request credits. Its own speech models target low-resource languages such as Kinyarwanda, Tagalog/Filipino, Cebuano and Oshiwambo, trained on native-speaker data.
